meta.title: Required API surface for the frontend Firebase decoupling
meta.purpose: Bounds the backend port: instead of porting all 105 exports of cms-functions.js, port the surface the frontend actually calls, then rewire the frontend file-by-file onto it.

derivedFrom.method: static extraction of firebase/firestore, firebase/auth, firebase/storage usage and postJSON/authedFetch call names from frontend/src; hook indirection (useFirestore.js) resolved by call-site scan

meta.constraint: azureConfig.js: the browser must not instantiate a Cosmos DB data-plane client or receive a Cosmos access key. Every direct Firestore touch below therefore needs a Functions endpoint.

rpc.description: Named functions the frontend already invokes through lib/api.js (postJSON/authedFetch). These are backend-routed today; the port is implementing them as Azure Functions HTTP handlers under the existing auth middleware. Source: Site-Main functions/cms-functions.js (105 exports) and labs-functions.js.
rpc.authModel: Entra bearer token via requireAdminClaims (replaces Firebase ID token in lib/api.js)

implemented.name: createContentItem
implemented.notes: Full source semantics: 4-stage dedup (409), per-target quality gate (422, forceQualityBypass honored), runEditorialCritique opt-out. Critique defaults to null until the AI model-router slice lands. Replaced the interim raw-upsert save placeholder at POST cms/content.

implemented.name: updateContentItem
implemented.notes: Partial write via patchDoc (never upsert). Full validation layer (protected-field denylist, dual-casing, size ceilings), version history to content_versions (/contentId partition), audit to admin_audit_logs. Firestore transaction became sequential writes, content patch first.

implemented.name: transitionContentStatus
implemented.notes: The state machine's single writer: VALID_TRANSITIONS table, per-status appliers, publisher-role gate on going live, legacy blogId fallback, audit to audits container. Deletions use patchDoc's undefined convention.

implemented.name: manageImagePromptConfig
implemented.notes: Five actions (saveSet/deleteSet/savePrompt/deletePrompt/savePageAssignment) verbatim. Firestore merge-sets became read-then-patch/upsert; batch deletes tolerate 404 like batch.delete. Prompt docs live in image_prompt_sets_prompts (/setName), legacy sets in image_prompts_sets (/pageId).

implemented.name: getCurrentAdminStatus
implemented.notes: Answers from the authoritative admins/{oid} registry record (not token claims — strictly harder to spoof than the source). Returns the source response shape incl. the permissions array the frontend gates UI on.

implemented.name: bootstrapCurrentUserAdmin
implemented.notes: Three-way gate preserved: locked (503) without the server-only allowlist, allowlisted first-admin path, super_admin-required thereafter. FINDING-06 upheld (no allow-any). Writes the registry + clears the guard role cache; the Entra Admin App Role directory assignment (gate 1) is the operator-side remainder, noted in the response.

implemented.name: recordAdminAudit
implemented.notes: Source validation (action ≤120, details object) and audit-row shape, uuid id + ISO timestamp.

implemented.name: upsertSpeakerEvent
implemented.notes: merge:true = patch-or-create, merge:false = full replace with creation stamps; Timestamp-like/date normalization to ISO.

implemented.name: deleteSpeakerEvent
implemented.notes: 404 on missing, reports deletedBy.

implemented.name: getQueueSnapshot
implemented.notes: Status-filter query shapes ported (in-lists via ARRAY_CONTAINS, count via SELECT VALUE COUNT), blocked-source filter, JS-side status/type nuances, admin projection. In-memory sort: docs missing the sort field sort last instead of vanishing (Firestore orderBy hid them).

implemented.name: getPublishSnapshot
implemented.notes: Ready bucket (approved/published, Live filtered out, cap 100) + published-live bucket with totals.

implemented.name: getAdminDashboardSnapshot
implemented.notes: Fast path from the stats doc (system/dashboard_stats_v1 — derived data, no migrated container) projected to the UI shape; self-seeds from a bounded full scan on first load, fire-and-forget.

implemented.name: recalculateDashboardStats
implemented.notes: Editor-gated full scan with slim projection; FULL overwrite of the stats doc (a recalculation must clear drifted keys).

implemented.name: getOpsHealthSnapshot
implemented.notes: The 10-query ops aggregation query-for-query: readiness counts, queue-breach cutoff (ISO comparison), staged ages, digest with the ORDER-BY-doc-id latest fallback (the source's own bug fix survives directly), alert signals, per-image orphan probes (bounded).

implemented.name: updateWorkflowAlert
implemented.notes: Publisher-gated acknowledge/resolve/reopen; resolve requires a note and auto-acknowledges; reopen writes explicit nulls (not deletions); audit row with before/after diff to audits.

implemented.name: saveEditorDraft
implemented.notes: Full validation (200k draft, tag/image ceilings, TL;DR shaping), edit-conflict 409 with force override — blogEditedAt comparison parses ISO strings (migrated-doc adaptation, else stale saves would silently win), image slot fan-out with cleared-slot deletions, version history + audit.

implemented.name: unpublishContentToInspected
implemented.notes: Publisher-gated; only from published/approved (legacy statuses normalized); clears Live/schedule, stamps review fields, audits the transition.

implemented.name: deleteContentItem
implemented.notes: Publisher-gated hard delete; tolerates missing docs like Firestore .delete().

implemented.name: saveContentSchedule
implemented.notes: Publisher-gated; approves + resolves target; instant clears the schedule, otherwise requires a future date (ISO stored).

implemented.name: softDeleteLivePage
implemented.notes: Publisher-gated archive with 24h softDeleteExpiresAt; blogId kept as legacy content-id alias; blogRefs fan-out already retired upstream.

implemented.name: requestContentInspection
implemented.notes: Editor-gated; arms inspectTrigger and returns status to ingested.

implemented.name: resetContentReviewState
implemented.notes: Editor-gated; disarms the trigger, clears inspectError/Live/schedule.

implemented.name: saveContentImageOrder
implemented.notes: Editor-gated; slot fan-out via buildContentImageUpdates, cleared slots as patchDoc deletions.

implemented.name: updateGalleryImageMetadata
implemented.notes: Partial metadata patch across both gallery collections; the source slot-guard fix preserved (absent slot never clears, explicit empty does); approvalStatus allowlisted.

implemented.name: createManualGalleryImageRecord
implemented.notes: Manual-upload record with the full source doc shape, fresh uuid id.

implemented.name: deleteCuratedGeneratedImage
implemented.notes: Blob delete via parseStorageRef (Azure URLs, legacy Google URLs, relative paths mapped onto the Terraform containers named after GCS prefixes); record delete proceeds regardless, storageDeleted reported.

implemented.name: deleteContentGeneratedImage
implemented.notes: Blob delete + slot/history scrub on the owning content doc (dotted-path patch with deletions) + record delete.

implemented.name: deleteRejectedContent
implemented.notes: Publisher-gated batch soft-delete of rejected docs with the olderThanHours age filter and single audit row; 499 clamp retained.

implemented.name: enqueueLabJob
implemented.notes: Editor-gated; LAB_JOB_TYPES allowlist verbatim with per-type payload byte caps (413) — the enqueue-side containment. Replaces the stub labs/jobs route, which accepted arbitrary job bodies.

implemented.name: getLabsSnapshot
implemented.notes: Viewer-gated; agents with 90s-heartbeat online math (ISO timestamps), 25 recent jobs, queue depth, job-type catalog — source response shape verbatim.

implemented.name: cancelLabJob
implemented.notes: Editor-gated; queued-only (404/409). Firestore transaction became read-then-patch; a lost race means the agent runs the job (it ignores cancels on claimed jobs) — annoying, not unsafe. submitPublicLabJob deliberately not ported (non-admin Firebase auth — the auth-swap phase).

implemented.name: publishContent
implemented.notes: The publish pipeline: publishable-status table, quality + image gates persisting failed reports, republish slug reuse vs collision-only suffixing (probe failure falls back to always-suffixed), metadata validation on new publishes, cover trigger (R1), forge stats via read-modify-write, version snapshot. scrapedImages re-hosting deliberately deferred to the asset-migration phase — publishes proceed with a surfaced warning.

implemented.name: publishSnapshot
implemented.notes: Sanitized _snapshots writer; the certification whitelist/hidden filter is the security boundary (must not leak more than the static JSON), carried verbatim incl. the GeoPoint flattening fix.

implemented.name: getLabJob
implemented.notes: viewer; one lab job with its output — replaces the LabsPage console's per-doc onSnapshot; projection only (payload not echoed)

notImplemented.description: Functions the frontend invokes TODAY that have no registered route — every call is a live 404 in the admin UI. Kept out of 'implemented' so the gap is visible and machine-checked (functions/src/functions/api-contract.test.js asserts functions = implemented + notImplemented exactly, and that none of these is registered). Implementing one of these REQUIRES moving it to 'implemented' in the same change, or the contract test fails.
notImplemented.blockedOn: Provider credentials — CHECKLIST.md section 4 (OpenAI/Anthropic keys, Klaviyo/Publer/Linkie tokens, MCP endpoints). The route scaffolding is not the blocker; shipping a proxy with nowhere to proxy to would be a 502 instead of a 404.

mismatches.resolution: HCW frontend renamed at useEditorState.js and PublishedPage.jsx (+test); payload fields verified identical to the source's destructuring

mismatches.resolution: Replaced by platform job type fetch-rss-feeds (functions/src/functions/rss-jobs.js + lib/rss/) — OpsHealthPage enqueues via runJob() and polls getJob; the same ingest runs on the syncRssFeeds timer. Flex Consumption caps HTTP at 230 s (T-322).

mismatches.resolution: Replaced by platform job type batch-inspect (functions/src/functions/inspect-jobs.js + lib/content/) which selects ingested documents AND runs the inspector on each; OpsHealthPage enqueues via runJob(). The change-feed trigger form is T-324.

Also serves one curated news image anonymously (T-210): the public news pages were calling the editor-gated cms equivalent, which throws without an MSAL account, so no imagery rendered for anonymous visitors. Frontend rewired via lib/publicApi.js + hooks/usePublicData.js (public slice)

realtime.decision: polling first; Azure SignalR Free_F1 recorded as the zero-cost upgrade path
realtime.rationale: All realtime consumers are admin surfaces with one operator. Cosmos change feed cannot be subscribed from a browser. Poll intervals of 10-30s match the labs agent's own pollFallbackIntervalMs design and add no moving parts.

limits.messagesPerDay: 20000 HARD CAP - no overage purchasable; delivery simply stops for the rest of the day

signalrOption.fitAssessment: 20 connections is ample for a single-operator admin. The 20k/day cap is the constraint: a 1 msg/sec stream exhausts it in ~5.5h, so it only fits EVENT-DRIVEN pushes (Cosmos change feed -> Functions output binding -> push on actual data change), never chatty streams.
cautions: Free -> Standard scaling incurs downtime: the public IP changes, 30-60 min DNS propagation
Standard_S1 (~$49/unit/month) is a third of the USD 150 platform ceiling and is NOT justified by one admin's dashboard
no SLA means the realtime layer can degrade with no recourse - polling fallback must remain in the client regardless
signalrOption.adoptionTrigger: only if polling proves sluggish in practice; ship polling first

authMigration.to: MSAL (lib/msalConfig.js already present) acquiring a token for entra_api_audience; lib/api.js swaps token source and base URL (VITE_GCP_FUNCTIONS_URL -> VITE_AZURE_FUNCTIONS_URL)
authMigration.note: verify-token.js on the backend already validates aud against the API registration — DECISION 3

storageMigration.to: Functions endpoints owning all blob access. Uploads are base64 JSON through POST cms/uploads/{container}; downloads are served by GET public/media/{container}/{*blobPath} through the Function App's managed identity. The SAS design described here was NOT built: the storage account is closed to the internet and allow_nested_items_to_be_public is false, so a browser-held SAS would have had nothing to talk to (TODO.md T-105). generateSasUrl still exists for server-side use and signs with a user delegation key.
storageMigration.note: the Function App identity already holds Storage Blob Data Contributor on the content account

portSequence: 1. cms-http slice: content list/get/save/delete with original semantics + tests (unblocks GET /api/cms/content and the RPC content functions) — DONE
2. public reads slice: /api/public/content*, snapshots, podcasts, feed (unblocks all public pages) — DONE
3. submissions endpoint with client-identity rate limiting (closes the open addDoc hole) — DONE
4. admin CRUD slices in the order of page usage: certifications, images, recordings, social, ai-providers, image-prompts, settings — DONE
5. auth swap in lib/api.js + AdminAuthGuard (MSAL), then storage SAS endpoints — DONE (uploads via POST cms/uploads/{container} base64 flow rather than SAS)

6. frontend rewiring file-by-file, each PR deleting its firebase/firestore import — DONE: zero firebase imports remain in frontend/src; useFirestore.js, firebaseConfig.js, firebaseStorage.js deleted; the production bundle carries no firebase chunk
